findings.title: Schema-3 material claims overstate review coverage of the current normative manifest
findings.requirement: A current-digest material-claim package must accurately report the scope of its structural and editorial review. A validation claim that all current normative state-machine material was reviewed must include every current heading or explicitly disclose omissions.
evidence: docs/state-transition-manifests.md currently has 27 numbered level-2/level-3 headings from §1 through §17.
material-claims.json coverage_validation.normative_manifest_heading_count_reviewed is 25 and normative_manifest_headings_reviewed lists 25 headings.

The list omits current §15.3.1 'Improvement rollback-coordinate machine v1' and §15.8 'Exact tuple witnesses required by the plan checker', both added or materially used by the round-5 rollback and reducer repairs.

The same object says normative_manifest_reviewed=true and assesses that the manifest's proposed state machines and completeness gates were reviewed. internal_validation.checks.all_25_normative_manifest_headings_reviewed=true and internal_validation.overall_status=pass merely validate the stale hard-coded set, not the 27-heading current manifest.
The artifact is bound to the current manifest digest, so this is not explained by regeneration against an older manifest.
findings.reproduction: Extract every Markdown heading matching levels 2-4 from docs/state-transition-manifests.md, excluding the document title, and compare the 27 numbered headings with material-claims.json coverage_validation.normative_manifest_headings_reviewed. The set difference is exactly {15.3.1 Improvement rollback-coordinate machine v1, 15.8 Exact tuple witnesses required by the plan checker}.
findings.impact: The evidence package reports complete current-manifest editorial review while omitting the two sections that carry key round-5 rollback and exact-tuple corrections. This is a material audit-coverage overclaim. It can cause a plan approver to treat those corrected contracts as included in a completed evidence review when the machine-readable coverage record does not establish that.
findings.recommendation: Review the two omitted sections, regenerate the coverage list and count from the current manifest headings rather than a hard-coded expected set, rename the check to all_current_normative_manifest_headings_reviewed, and fail validation on any current-heading set difference. If they were not reviewed, mark them omitted with an explicit reason and remove the complete-review assertion.
findings.verification: The regenerated artifact's heading count and exact heading set equal the current manifest's numbered heading set, including §§15.3.1 and 15.8; the validation check derives that equality from the current bytes and no longer passes a stale 25-heading expectation.

residual_uncertainty: No implementation, full reachable-product/model proof, operational safety proof, external source retrieval, or human semantic entailment review was required or inferred by this plan-only audit.
The plan's future Increment 0/1 and later admission gates remain future work and are not findings.
